overview: The Tenebrous Cliffs are the jagged skyline of the mountains, shaped by resonance winds and predator dominance.
history: The cliffs formed from ancient volcanic upheaval and Umbral erosion.
Razorfiends claimed the heights long before vampyres or Akheva arrived.
Vampyric scouts built hidden watch-spires to monitor the Borderlands.
Akhevan scouts established ledges for shadow incursions into the mountains.
hooks: A cliffside collapse reveals a new predator nest.
Vampyric scouts signal an approaching resonance storm.
Akhevan ledges show signs of ritual activity.
Umbral winds intensify, altering cliff hazards.
